label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Unity MCP Application at exact World interface world_mcp_unity. Installation proves only that the package owners are present; project availability, exact task binding, and a live Unity MCP server are separate facts. Use the emitted mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates, and mcp.prompt_catalog artifacts as the current server evidence; never invent Unity tool names or argument schemas. To invoke a discovered Unity tool, emit an ordinary artifact.send to world_mcp_unity with label mcp.operation.request and a payload whose operation is unity.call_tool and whose arguments carry the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use unity.list_tools to refresh the catalog, unity.read_resource and unity.get_prompt only with exact catalog identifiers, and unity.status or unity.ping when liveness or negotiated capability matters. A sent request is not proof of a Unity edit, import, test, build, or play-mode effect: wait for the returned MCP result, resource, event, or refusal artifact and report failures honestly. The Unity MCP server remains an external Application endpoint; Octopus does not silently start it or assume the Editor is open.
